WHY WE’RE HERE

Knowing what to do
is only part of the work.

Daily life involves more than keeping a list. It means deciding where to begin, remembering context, adjusting when plans change, and carrying responsibilities that other people may never see.

01

Support that meets you where you are

For neurodivergent people, individuals with disabilities, and families navigating the demands of daily life.

02

Less effort to get going

Tools designed to reduce decisions, make the next step clearer, and help turn intention into action.

03

More room for your life

Our goal is practical support that respects your energy, your priorities, and your way of doing things.

OUR FIRST PRODUCT

Meet AddvancedFocus.

In development

Help with starting, planning,
and keeping everyday life moving.

Our flagship AI-powered executive-function assistant is being developed to support ADHD, autism, and the everyday work of planning, routines, and household coordination.

HOW WE BUILD

Care belongs
in the details.

These principles guide the choices we’re making as we develop our products.

01

Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 Level AA is the design target for this website. Read the accessibility statement

02

Privacy

This website has no sign-up, live AI request, analytics script, or marketing cookie.

03

User autonomy

In the demo, you can stop a session without marking the step complete, and undo a completion.

04

Affordability

Practical value at an accessible price is a design requirement.
